description:
CITY BAR & THREE-BEDROOM APARTMENT, MAIN STREET, CASHEL

A rare opportunity to acquire a prominent mixed-use town centre property on Main Street, Cashel, comprising the established City Bar — a fully licensed premises — together with a spacious, modern three-bedroom apartment situated directly above. The property is offered for sale as a single lot.

City Bar
The City Bar is a well-established and fully licensed public house occupying a prominent trading position on Main Street, Cashel. The premises offers an excellent opportunity for an owner-operator or investor to acquire a going concern in a strong town centre location, with the added benefit of self-contained residential accommodation overhead.

The Apartment
The apartment is accessed independently from Main Street and is laid out over two floors. The first floor provides a bright and generously proportioned open-plan kitchen, living and dining area, offering a modern and comfortable living space. The kitchen is finished in a contemporary style and connects seamlessly with the living and dining areas, creating an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining.

The top floor comprises three well-proportioned bedrooms, providing excellent accommodation for a family, professional couple or those looking for a centrally located town residence. This floor also includes a useful store room/laundry area and a modern bathroom.

The apartment is regularly let on Booking.com and Airbnb, making it a great turnkey investment opportunity for a buyer looking for an income-generating property from day one.

Location
One of the main advantages of the property is its exceptionally convenient town centre location. Situated directly on Main Street, the property is within easy walking distance of Cashel's wide range of shops, cafes, restaurants, pubs, schools, services and amenities. The property also benefits from excellent road connections, with easy access to the M8 motorway and surrounding towns.

Summary
This is a unique opportunity to acquire a fully licensed public house together with a substantial three-bedroom apartment, in a highly prominent and convenient town centre location — ideal for an owner-occupier, business owner or investor seeking a combined commercial and residential investment with proven short-term letting income.  

For any further inquiries, feel free to reach out to our Sales Team via email or phone. Please note that we have not tested any appliances, fixtures, fittings, or services, and interested parties are encouraged to carry out their own investigations regarding their functionality. All measurements are approximate, and photographs are provided for guidance only. Viewing strictly by appointment only through Maher Auctioneers, 062 61221.
